capabilities: Generate Lite or Full concept cards from selected text via an OpenAI-compatible provider
File cards into vault folders by type with duplicate protection
Link cards back to the source note at the extracted keyword
Schedule card reviews with a sidebar panel and status-bar counts
Write review reminders into the matching Daily Note
disambiguation: Not a flashcard app; cards are structured concept notes with sections and a review schedule, not question-answer pairs.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; Chinese documentation is available in README.zh-CN.md; generated content may be inaccurate and should be verified against the source.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to extract a selected passage into a fixed-structure concept note that is filed, backlinked, and scheduled for review.

relations.evidence: An OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama (local), or a custom gateway.
